answer: Resisting sybil attacks requires each identity to bear a non-replicable cost. New agents must stake and lock tokens for N epochs while proving real computation. Reputation is non-transferable and permanently recorded on-chain. Clustered fake identities sharing fingerprints are detected instantly. An attacker forging N fake identities pays N times stake and N times compute. The summit of security is reached when the fable of easy sybil gains ends and timber-strong locks make cost exceed profit at scale.
